name: Environment Protection Act, 1986
change: An umbrella legislation providing the central government authority to regulate pollution, set environmental standards, and control hazardous substances across industries.
impact: Forms the backbone of environmental governance in India and enables regulation of industrial pollution. However, enforcement challenges remain in many regions.

name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
change: Established Central and State Pollution Control Boards to monitor and regulate water pollution and enforce standards for waste discharge.
impact: Improves water quality management and industrial regulation, though implementation varies across states.

name: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
change: Provides a framework for controlling air pollution through emission standards and regulatory oversight by pollution control boards.
impact: Helps monitor and reduce air pollution levels, especially in industrial zones and urban areas.

name: Forest Conservation Act, 1980
change: Restricts the diversion of forest land for non-forest purposes without central government approval.
impact: Prevents deforestation and protects biodiversity, though development vs conservation conflicts continue.

name: Biological Diversity Act, 2002
change: Regulates access to biological resources and promotes conservation through national and local biodiversity authorities.
impact: Protects biodiversity and traditional knowledge, but awareness and enforcement need improvement.

name: National Action Plan on Climate Change, 2008
change: Introduced eight national missions focusing on solar energy, water conservation, sustainable agriculture, and climate research.
impact: Provides a comprehensive framework for climate action and guides state-level climate policies. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: National Green Tribunal Act, 2010
change: Established a specialized tribunal for fast-track resolution of environmental disputes and enforcement of environmental laws.
impact: Improves legal enforcement and accountability in environmental cases, though backlog issues still exist.

name: Green India Mission, 2014
change: Focuses on increasing forest cover and restoring degraded ecosystems through community participation and sustainable practices.
impact: Enhances carbon sequestration and biodiversity while supporting rural livelihoods.

name: National Clean Air Programme, 2019
change: Targets reduction of particulate pollution in major cities through monitoring, emission control, and public awareness initiatives.
impact: Improves urban air quality and public health, though achieving targets remains challenging.

name: Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment), 2022
change: Encourages individuals and communities to adopt environmentally sustainable habits such as reducing waste and conserving resources.
impact: Promotes behavioral change alongside policy measures, supporting long-term sustainability goals.
